steps.title: This project is yours alone
steps.body: "Constellation 101 — Training" is a private practice project. Nobody else can see it, nothing you do here reaches the club's real reporting, and it's archived when you finish this course. Break whatever you like.

steps.title: Open the Tasks tab
steps.body: A project has several views. The board is the one you'll live in.

steps.title: To-do
steps.body: Agreed on, not started. If it's in here, someone has decided it should happen.

steps.title: In progress
steps.body: Someone is actively working on it right now. If a card sits here for three weeks, that's information — it usually means it's blocked and nobody said so.

steps.title: Blocked
steps.body: Stopped by something outside the task itself. Constellation moves cards here on its own when you attach a blocker or add a dependency — you'll do both in module 3.

steps.title: Done
steps.body: Finished, by the definition written in the task — not "mostly finished." Moving a card here is what triggers XP.

steps.title: Filter the noise
steps.body: On a real project this board is long. Filter by assignee, priority, milestone, or tag to get down to what you care about.

steps.title: Assign by dragging
steps.body: These chips are draggable. Drop one on a card to assign that person — faster than opening the task when you're triaging a dozen of them.

steps.title: Open a task
steps.body: Click this card. The board shows you a summary; the real record is inside.

steps.title: This is the specification
steps.body: Scope, non-scope, and acceptance criteria. When you disagree with someone about whether something is finished, this is the thing you both read.
